title: 礼来公司38亿美元收：迷幻药开发商曾处边缘，能否复制Spravato的成
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What exactly is Lily buying with this thing? Yes, so Lily is buying into this fast growing psychedelic space, which was once really on the fringes of drug development,
segments.zh: 礼来这次收购的是什么？礼来正在进入快速增长的迷幻药领域，这曾处于药物开发的边缘，

segments.en: but has gotten a lot more interesting and a lot more interest from drug makers over the last year or so.
segments.zh: 但过去一年左右，制药商对此兴趣大增。

segments.en: There are now a couple of companies that are nearing potentially FDA approval.
segments.zh: 现在有几家公司接近获得FDA批准。

segments.en: They're in late stages of testing, a tie-backly is moving into late stages of testing.
segments.zh: 它们处于后期测试阶段，AtaiBeckly也正进入后期测试。

segments.en: They have their lead drug, it's called BPL003, it's actually a derivative or closely related to DMT.
segments.zh: 其主要药物BPL003是DMT的衍生物，

segments.en: And it's an intranasal spray that is supposed to help with treatment-resistant depression.
segments.zh: 是一种鼻内喷雾，用于治疗难治性抑郁症。

segments.en: So it's similar to Jane J. Spravato, which is a drug that's already approved for treatment-resistant depression.
segments.zh: 类似于已获批的Spravato，也是鼻喷雾剂，

segments.en: It's a nasal spray, and that drug has really created the infrastructure to allow things like this to have success in the market.
segments.zh: 该药已为这类药物在市场成功创造了基础设施。

segments.en: Yeah, what is the uptake on that drug, Marie? And then will the FDA just approve all of the rest of them because this is all accepted now and promoted?
segments.zh: Spravato的市场接受度如何？FDA会因此批准所有类似药物吗？

segments.en: Yeah, so Jane J. Spravato, which is technically not a psychedelic, but kind of similar, has really opened the door to acceptance to these kinds of therapies.
segments.zh: Spravato虽非严格意义上的迷幻药，但类似，已为这类疗法打开了接受之门。

segments.en: It's taken a few years, it was approved, I think, over five years ago at this point, and it was sort of slow to take off.
segments.zh: 这款药获批已有五年多，起初推广缓慢。

segments.en: But now it is a blockbuster drug for Jane J, and a lot of clinics around the country have gotten more comfortable with prescribing something like this that requires patients to actually be in the clinic and be monitored for a couple of hours after getting a drug, just to make sure it's safe for them to drive home and things like that.
segments.zh: 但现在已成为Jane J的重磅药物，全国许多诊所更愿意开具此类需患者留院观察数小时的处方，确保用药后安全驾车回家。
